What it is

ageLOC® Youth

According to Nu Skin material, every cell has natural defenses against the effects of aging, but over time those defenses can weaken. ageLOC Youth is a blend of nutrients chosen because their anti-aging benefits have been studied, to help support those defenses.

The material also says this blend is hard to get at the same levels from everyday food, even a healthy diet. One thing you can measure: ageLOC Youth is SCS-certified, so it can raise the Skin Carotenoid Score on the scanner.

Who it suits

Adults who want to look after their body and energy as they age. If you avoid fish, note that this product contains fish.

Good to know

Before you start

If you are pregnant, nursing or taking prescription medication, consult a physician before use. Stop use 2 weeks before and after surgery. Stop and see a physician if any adverse reaction occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if the safety seal is broken or missing.

FAQ

Common questions

What are “aging defense mechanisms”?

According to Nu Skin material, these are the body’s ways of resisting the effects of aging. With age, changes in gene expression make them decline. ageLOC Youth is described as helping to maintain their activity.

Why is the blend hard to get from food?

Nu Skin material explains that it contains concentrated extracts standardized for active compounds. Those amounts would be hard to reach regularly from food, even a balanced diet. Twice a day gives consistent levels.

Will ageLOC Youth raise my scanner score?

According to Nu Skin material, ageLOC Youth is SCS-certified to raise your Skin Carotenoid Score. Results can differ from person to person.

What is the scientific substantiation?

Nu Skin material lists many clinical studies on the benefits of the ingredients, and says several studies on ageLOC Youth itself are completed or ongoing. The full study list is in its official product information sheet.

What goes well with it?

Nu Skin material lists ageLOC R2, G3 and LifePak as complements.
